description: Get a link to a collection's places as one file: csv, json or xlsx. The file has the places the collection holds now, even if it is still running. The link opens without an API key for 24 hours, so share it only with people who should see the file. Needs an API key. Costs no credits.

collectionId.description: The collection to export, as create_collection or search_places returned it.

format.description: The file type: csv, json or xlsx. An xlsx file holds up to 50,000 places.

locale.description: The language of the column names in csv and xlsx files: en or pt-BR. Defaults to your account's language.

name: create_export
title: Export a collection
